questions.prompt: A camera uploads footage to a recording server. The camera is considered an endpoint in this design. Which evidence identifies the recording host’s server role?

choices.text: It has a shorter Ethernet cable
choices.explanation: Cable length does not establish application role.

choices.text: Its MAC address starts with a lower number
choices.explanation: Numeric MAC ordering does not identify servers.

choices.text: It must never initiate any other network connection
choices.explanation: A server can also initiate separate client interactions.

choices.text: It accepts the camera’s uploads and provides the recording service
choices.explanation: Providing the requested service establishes its role in this interaction.

questions.explanation: Endpoint and server classifications describe the device’s role in the service being examined. Hardware appearance or address order is not decisive.

questions.prompt: In a basic leaf-spine fabric, all spines are healthy but one leaf fails. Servers are single-homed to that failed leaf. What does the spine redundancy provide those servers?

choices.text: Automatic attachment to another leaf without another link
choices.explanation: No alternate server-to-leaf link exists.

choices.text: Automatic wireless access to every spine
choices.explanation: No radio access is specified.

choices.text: No replacement for their failed only attachment point
choices.explanation: Redundant spines cannot bypass a lost sole server access link.

choices.text: A new virtual NIC inside every server
choices.explanation: Spines do not create host NICs.

questions.explanation: Redundancy must cover the actual failed dependency. Multiple fabric paths do not make a single server attachment redundant.

questions.prompt: A TCP receiver advertises a receive window of zero while its application is temporarily unable to drain the receive buffer. What does that signal to the sender?

choices.text: Change to UDP without notifying the application
choices.explanation: TCP does not silently replace its transport.

choices.text: The path has no Ethernet carrier
choices.explanation: A receive window is not a physical link-status field.

choices.text: The receiver currently advertises no space for additional ordinary data
choices.explanation: Flow control limits sending according to the available receive window.

choices.text: All previously acknowledged data must be resent immediately
choices.explanation: Zero window does not invalidate all previous acknowledgments.

questions.explanation: The advertised window reflects receiver-side flow control. TCP has mechanisms for detecting when the window opens again; it need not abandon the connection immediately.

choices.explanation: 250 is 11111010, not contiguous leading ones followed by zeros.

choices.text: All valid masks must end in 255
choices.explanation: Many valid masks end in zero.

choices.text: Masks may contain only 255 and 0

choices.text: It is an IPv6-only mask

choices.text: Unknown-unicast flooding targets only VLAN 1
choices.explanation: It follows the actual ingress VLAN.

choices.text: Every unknown frame must first become a broadcast address
choices.explanation: The original destination remains unchanged.

choices.text: Flooding uses eligible operational forwarding ports
choices.explanation: VLAN membership alone does not make a down port usable.
